profile.name: Faizal Kusuma
profile.title: Video Editor · Videographer · Content Producer · Filmmaker
profile.title_en: Video Editor · Videographer · Content Producer · Filmmaker
profile.about: Saya video editor, videographer, content producer, dan filmmaker dengan pengalaman 4+ tahun di konten komersial, kampanye digital, branded content, sosial media, dan film independen. Kerja saya ada di antara storytelling dan strategi: mencari bahasa visual yang pas supaya sebuah ide bukan cuma enak dilihat, tapi juga nyambung dengan penontonnya. Lulusan Film/Video Universitas Dian Nuswantoro (2019–2023).
profile.about_en: I am a video editor, videographer, content producer and filmmaker with 4+ years of experience across commercial content, digital campaigns, branded content, social media and independent film. My work sits between storytelling and strategy, finding the right visual language so an idea not only looks good but connects with its audience. Film/Video graduate of Universitas Dian Nuswantoro (2019–2023).
